histories.history: Renumbered and Amended by Chapter 172, 2025 General Session

section.catchline: Time for filing claim for renter's credit -- One claimant per household per year.
section.subsection: The commission may not allow or pay a renter's credit unless the claim is actually filed with, and in the possession of, the commission on or before December 31 of each calendar year.
Only one claimant per household per calendar year is entitled to payment under this part.
